about: Reviewed DD2 engine emission summary (ids/counts only). The emitted rows are D5 native aliases; no extension rows. Text is read from the user's own game files at build time, never stored here.
limits: Exact describes the reviewed contract, not native D4/DD2 equivalence.
The D5 alias relation is the Kit hook in patches/evilities/aliases.json; it is not an extension row.
Uncovered rows cannot be produced until the named capability exists in the native evaluator.
